images.seen: Kush holds a block of the Egyptian Western Desert (Matruh) and Eastern Desert while the 25th Dynasty is a Nile ribbon; Phrygia small against Cliopatria's large shape; otherwise matches Cliopatria.

Matches Cliopatria in outline (Median, Scythia, Lydia, Urartu, Babylon holding Assyria plus the Levant, 26th Dynasty whole Egypt); a Scythian patch round Lake Urmia and Persia/Fars as Median vassal tint look intended.

Wrong: Kush drawn as a donut round Egypt (New Valley and Red Sea governorates, about 1,500 cells) with the 25th Dynasty a one-cell Nile ribbon inside it; Assyria holding Sinai and a strip of the Matruh coast four years before the 671 conquest.

Lydia stretched to Ankara and Eskisehir ten years before the dated expansion; Scythia holds the Urartu highlands while Urartu is a strip (per the ledger, left); contests Assyria/Babylon and Elam occupation drawn.

Wrong: Wu drawn as two discs, one at Wuxi and a second on the Huai in northern Anhui (Suzhou homonym); Ba disc and the many small Zhou states look fine; Yiqu is the dossier's generous Ordos-Ningxia-Gansu reading.
Kush is Nubia only, the 25th Dynasty holds the Nile Valley and Delta, deserts are unowned, Assyria no longer holds Sinai or the Matruh strip.
Wu is one blob round Taihu (Wuxi and Suzhou, Jiangsu); the Anhui disc is gone.
Identical in the Levant and Sinai: the Negev strip and the 26th's Egypt are unchanged by the Assyria -675 override.
Lydia is the -650 shape (Aegean coast to about 31E) until the -620 expansion.

issues.what: Wu's core drawn as two discs: the spec {place: Suzhou, km: 60} resolves to Suzhou in Anhui (117.0E 33.6N, about 600 km from Wuxi), 60 cells of Wu on the Huai from -750 to -585.

Egypt drawn twice: Kush's -700 and -675 keyframes (Cliopatria's all-Egypt shape; the region Upper Egypt) overlap the Twenty-fifth Dynasty's Nile Valley keyframes, so the dynasty got a one-cell ribbon and Kush the Western and Eastern Deserts (about 1,500 cells, -700 to -656). Kush cut to Nubia; Egypt is the dynasty's alone.

Assyria's -675 keyframe (shape minus Upper Egypt only) handed it Sinai and a Matruh-coast strip (about 190 cells) four years before Esarhaddon took Memphis in 671; 258 cell-years of conflict with the 25th Dynasty. Egypt (country) cut from the keyframe; the ledger's 671 and later gains stand.

Lydia's large shape (255,000 km2) snapped in at -630 (556 cells) although the dossier's text, from the Phrygia page, dates the expansion over Phrygia to after about 620; lydia_-650 and lydia_-630 given explicit years (-650..-621, -620..-616).

kingdom-of-urartu / scythia, 435 cell-years at -615: Scythia's ledger gain of Urartu at -635 (Scythians page, 'Madyes conquered Urartu') leaves Urartu a 131-cell rump for 20 years, then Urartu's -615 keyframe takes its 568 cells back. The Urartu page keeps Urartian kings (Erimena, Rusa III, Rusa IV) to 590, speaks of 'constant attacks' and gives no border; neither page settles who held the highlands -635..-616.
median-kingdom -615 snap of 4,120 cells at the founding year.

phrygia -700 (+394 cells), neo-assyrian-empire -700 (+380/-185), sabaeans -675 (-262) and neo-babylonian-empire -605 snaps: steps in Cliopatria's shapes, already reviewed in the dossiers (Cliopatria is the shape of record); no event contradicts them.
greek-city-states / neo-assyrian-empire in Cyprus (50 cell-years, -650..-620) and neo-assyrian-empire / philistia (82): small; occupation of Philistia is already drawn.

Homonym scan of every place spec in the dossiers alive in the window: only Wu's Suzhou resolves wrongly (Sinop, Houma, Aurangabad and Al Hillah resolve to the intended town); no ambiguous admin-1 names without a country.

colour_clashes.note: Both #9d3629 (distance 0); assyrian-egypt is drawn as a colony/vassal in the suzerain's tint, so the tint separates them, but its own colour should differ. No other pair under 0.08 among the visible neighbours (kingdom-of-kush / twenty-fifth-dynasty-of-egypt 0.125, scythia / neo-assyrian-empire 0.107, lydia / kingdom-of-urartu 0.102).

dossier_requests.what: Ledger events 4-11 (-671 to -656: contest, loss and gain of Memphis, the Delta and Upper Egypt against Assyria) duplicate the twenty-fifth-dynasty-of-egypt dossier's events for the same land; with the Kush keyframes now Nubia only, Kush still takes the Delta (263 cells) at -669 through its own gain event while the dynasty's keyframe finds it 'kept by others'.
dossier_requests.why: The Twenty-fifth Dynasty page treats Kush and Egypt as one Kushite realm ('Kushite power stretched from the Mediterranean Sea to the present Ethiopian boundary'); the dossiers split it into Nubia (Kush) and Egypt (dynasty), so Egypt's events belong to the dynasty alone.

dossier_requests.what: Keyframe wu_-1100 (-1100..-751) has the same {place: Suzhou, km: 60} spec as wu_-750 and draws the second disc in Anhui; my patch corrects wu_-750 only because wu_-1100 lies outside the window.
dossier_requests.why: Wu's early capitals were in Jiangsu (Meili in Wuxi, then Gusu at Suzhou); the place name resolves to Suzhou, Anhui. Use {lon: 120.62, lat: 31.30, km: 60} in place of the Suzhou spec.

problems: Boundary: keyframe_overrides/0 replaces wu_-750, whose first year is -750, so the -750 snap in m0800-m0701 changes too (the same Suzhou fix); wu_-1100 (-1100..-751) still has the error and belongs to earlier windows (see dossier_requests).

Boundary: the Kush seam. At 1 January -700 the start anchor still has Kush holding Matruh and the Egyptian deserts (2,162 cells, set by m0800-m0701's ledger events and kingdom-of-kush_-800); my -700 override removes them in -700 (1,010 cells). If m0800-m0701 trims kingdom-of-kush_-800 the same way the jump disappears; the first file in window order wins on any shared keyframe.

kingdom-of-kush_-700 override keeps the dossier's years (-700..-676) although its correction text says -727..-671; the compile cannot express the text. The 25th Dynasty's own keyframes cover Egypt for those years.

After the patch the Egyptian deserts (Western Desert, Eastern Desert) are unowned from -700 to -656, then the 26th Dynasty takes the whole country at -655 (1,010 cells from nobody); the 25th Dynasty dossier draws the Nile Valley only, the 26th the whole country.

Trial shows neo-assyrian-empire_-615 now adds 163 cells (was 68): Cliopatria's -615 shape returns the Sinai cells the -675 keyframe no longer pre-holds; the -614 render is identical before and after, so no visible change.
No hierarchy.csv row was found wrong from the images and the packet's relation table (the rows were not checked against pages).
Dating note: the Lydia page gives no year for the extension over Phrygia (only Alyattes' accession in 635); the Phrygia page says 'by around 620 BC'. The patch follows the dated page.
